why: Checks 1 and 2 pass; check 3 kills it. (1) The quote is VERBATIM at authentication.md:143, and the whole two-line neighbourhood supports the claimed behaviour: :144 is 'by default, `apiKeyHelper` is called after 5 minutes or on HTTP 401 response. Set `CLAUDE_CODE_API_KEY_HELPER_TTL_MS` environment variable for custom refresh intervals.' Nothing in the second half reverses it. (2) The cited file says what was claimed: resolveAuthEnvVars (packages/shared/src/config/llm-connections.ts:1021-1076) assembles ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN / ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL and has no helper path. (3) The CONSEQUENCE is false, and it is the archetypal shape this repo keeps hitting -- the identifier is genuinely absent from first-party TypeScript while the mechanism is live one layer down, because the claimed grep was scoped to packages/ and apps/ and therefore excluded the dependency that IMPLEMENTS it. The native Claude Agent SDK binary contains apiKeyHelper's full runtime -- `grep -c -a CLAUDE_CODE_API_KEY_HELPER_TTL_MS node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk-darwin-arm64/claude` returns 7 (the JS core returns 0), and the binary carries the doc's own strings 'apiKeyHelper is taking a while', 'apiKeyHelper failed', 'apiKeyHelper is configured'. That binary is staged into the shipped app (scripts/build/common.ts:324-371 aliases claude-agent-sdk-darwin-<arch> to @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk-binary; apps/electron/scripts/build-dmg.sh:169-189 and build-linux.sh:147 do the same). And our own code opens every seam the helper needs, deliberately: buildClaudeTurnShapeOptions passes settingSources: ['user','project','local'] explicitly (packages/shared/src/agent/claude-agent.ts:305, with the comment 'Omitting this loads all three sources (CLI defaults). Spelling out the same three keeps today's behavior'), so an apiKeyHelper entry in a project .claude/settings.json, .claude/settings.local.json, or the per-Workspace user scope under CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR (packages/shared/src/agent/options.ts:222-255) is read by the CLI; buildClaudeSubprocessEnv (options.ts:236-263) spreads the entire host process.env and deletes only three Bedrock keys, so CLAUDE_CODE_API_KEY_HELPER_TTL_MS propagates unmodified -- 'no CLAUDE_CODE_API_KEY_HELPER_TTL_MS' is true of our source and false of our runtime; and addClaudePermissionRules (packages/shared/src/agent/claude-settings-store.ts:118-164) merge-preserves unknown keys, so nothing we write strips the entry. The one real difference is precedence, and it is the SAME page's documented precedence working as specified, not a gap: for an anthropic connection with authType 'api_key' we inject ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (llm-connections.ts:1042-1045), which authentication.md:170 ranks 3rd, above apiKeyHelper at 4th, so the helper is shadowed there; on authType 'oauth' we inject CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN (llm-connections.ts:1057), rank 5, which apiKeyHelper OUTRANKS, so a vault-backed helper does supply the credential. isValidProviderAuthCombination limits anthropic to ['api_key','oauth'] (llm-connections.ts:801). The sibling-subsystem trap also applies to the closing sentence: authentication.md governs the Claude CLI's credential resolution, so measuring it against the Nessy Gateway dp flow and NESSY_DP_AUTH_TOKEN names the wrong subsystem -- the Pi / Codex / Nestor paths are the fork's deliberate corporate-gateway product difference, not this page's contract. Not one of the nine dated owner decisions in 2026-07-29-inert-worklist.md section 3 (read all nine at :89-97; none concerns apiKeyHelper).
correctedState: apiKeyHelper is present and functional on the surface this page governs. The shipped native Claude Agent SDK binary implements the helper, its 10-second slow notice and CLAUDE_CODE_API_KEY_HELPER_TTL_MS (7 occurrences in the binary, 0 in the JS core), and it is staged into the packaged app by scripts/build/common.ts:324-371. Our first-party code opens the seam rather than closing it: claude-agent.ts:305 passes settingSources: ['user','project','local'] explicitly so a settings-file apiKeyHelper is loaded (user scope resolving under the per-Workspace CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR set at options.ts:255), options.ts:236-263 forwards the whole host env minus three Bedrock keys so the TTL override reaches the consumer, and claude-settings-store.ts:118-164 merge-preserves unknown settings keys. What is true is narrower and is Claude's own documented precedence, not a missing mechanism: an anthropic connection with authType 'api_key' has ANTHROPIC_API_KEY injected by resolveAuthEnvVars (llm-connections.ts:1042-1045), which outranks apiKeyHelper (rank 3 vs 4 at authentication.md:170), so the helper is shadowed on that authType; on authType 'oauth' the injected CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN is rank 5 and apiKeyHelper wins, so rotating vault credentials do have a supported path.
